Pure Local PostgreSQL Database Engine + Node.js (Express/Fastify) Backend
Relational Multi-Tenancy via PostgreSQL Row-Level Security (RLS) & Local Session Variables

This document outlines the operational, structural, and security architecture for BashaCare. By migrating to a completely local PostgreSQL instance, the platform prioritizes structural integrity, relational querying power, and localized hardware execution speed over cloud-based backend-as-a-service solutions. This blueprint dictates exact data structures, programmatic triggers, and constraints required to build the backend.
Enforce data multi-tenancy at the database level using PostgreSQL Row-Level Security (RLS). This prevents any accidental data leaks between landlords.
Implement an append-only relational line-item transaction ledger. This tracks all payments, partial settlements, and carried-forward balances.
Calculate variable billing cycles using delta-meter equations. These are processed directly via relational database triggers.

Support diverse financial reconciliation, including automated MFS merchant gateways, manual MFS transfers, bank transfers, and cash payments, alongside high-deliverability messaging paths (WhatsApp/SMS).

Instead of building custom data-filtering layers in your application code, BashaCare handles multi-tenancy natively inside the database using PostgreSQL Row-Level Security (RLS). Since we are bypassing third-party auth for now, this will rely on database session variables.
